router_guardrail_ownership._note: Re-expressed in DISCRETE terms 2026-08-04 per routing-feedback-router-merge-handoff.md §2.4.6. The retired continuous vocabulary ('bounded_adjustment_cap' as a -0.15 magnitude, 'effective_score_floor') described an adjustment surface the resolver does not have: selection is by chain position and integer within-model priority, with no score to cap or floor. A magnitude cap is meaningless when there is exactly one available action, so boundedness comes from displacement limits and hysteresis instead. All rows below are IMPLEMENTED in routing-feedback.js and covered by tests/test-routing-feedback.js.
router_guardrail_ownership.max_rank_displacement: implemented — 1 position, demotion-only; promotion is forbidden
router_guardrail_ownership.never_empty_last_candidate_floor: implemented — actuation is a permutation, so no candidate is ever removed; single-entry chains are a hard no-op
router_guardrail_ownership.hysteresis_and_ttl: implemented — demote at theta 0.15, restore below theta_restore 0.08, override expires after 1 window unless re-confirmed
router_guardrail_ownership.human_override_wins: absolute — structural, via physically separate channels: machine state is ~/.claude/state/routing-feedback-overrides.json and NEVER routing.local.toml
router_guardrail_ownership.must_stay_primary_immunity: absolute — enforced at the join validator, the actuation stage, and the record emitter
router_guardrail_ownership.feature_flag_disable: implemented — AOS_ROUTING_FEEDBACK=0|false|no|off, instant, plus this contract's live_consumption gate
router_guardrail_ownership.routing_record_provenance: implemented — RoutingRecord.routing_feedback carries rank_displacement (action) plus combined_signal and the §2.2 evidence block (reason)

retired_continuous_vocabulary.bounded_adjustment_cap: retired as a magnitude; |0.15| re-purposed as the demotion threshold theta
retired_continuous_vocabulary.effective_score_floor: retired as unsatisfiable; replaced by never_empty_last_candidate_floor
retired_continuous_vocabulary.score_delta: retired as a RoutingRecord field; replaced by rank_displacement
